description: K₃NaHf₂(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.62-2.92 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.61 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.14 Å) Hf-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.65 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, one Hf, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Hf, and one Si atom.
